This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Addl. Standing Counsel for the State.
3.

The Petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with Pirahat PS Case No.225 of 2023,
corresponding to G.R Case No.2672 of 2023 registered and pending on the file of learned S.D.J.M,
Bhadrak for the alleged commission of the offence under Sections 376/379/354-A of I.P.C.
4.

Considering the nature of accusations, the materials on record, the age of the victim and her statement recorded under Section // 2 // 161 of Cr.P.C., I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the Petitioner.

The ABLAPL is however, disposed of granting liberty to the Petitioner to surrender before the Court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and to move for bail.
In such event, he shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as may be deemed fit and proper by the said Court.
